subject: Ensuring non-replication & certified snapshot tombstone for VPC tenants

Subject: Customer request: proof non-replication + tombstone evidence for VPC snapshots

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our compliance review we need a short technical note that explains two things for our private VPC deployment:

1) That snapshots of our customer-controlled storage are never replicated outside the chosen region (no cross-region replication), including any internal replication for durability; specifically what mechanisms prevent background replication and where artifact copies (snapshots) may transiently exist.

2) The process you use to mark snapshots as "tombstoned" and the evidence we can expect when a tenant requests a certified erase — e.g., signed logs, snapshot tombstone metadata, and cryptographic key destruction proof.

Could you provide a concise Q&A or an attestation we can take to our audit team? We'd like items we can attach to our SOC 2 evidence; a PDF attestation plus a checklist of artifacts would be ideal.

We appreciate a timeline — our audit window is the week of Oct 20.

Hi Priya,

Thanks — we can produce both a short attestation and a checklist of artifacts. Looping in Rishi (inference infra) and Karthik (security/compliance) to confirm the technical artifacts and timeline.

High-level answers up front so you can share with auditors quickly:
- Non-replication: For Private/VPC deployments we do not enable automated cloud-provider cross-region snapshot replication by default. Durable copies for redundancy are kept only within the customer's selected region and within the allocated availability zones. We will supply the configuration flags and the control-plane policy that enforces that.
- Tombstone + evidence: We can produce a signed tombstone event (time-stamped), the snapshot metadata containing the tombstone marker, an audit log trace showing the snapshot lifecycle events, and evidence of key rotation/destruction when requested (HSM/KMS audit entries).

Rishi/Karthik — can you confirm the exact artifacts we can export and a realistic delivery date? I told Priya the week of Oct 20 would be ideal.

Hi all,

Brief technical summary and the concrete artifacts we can provide:

1) Non-replication controls
- Configuration: Private deployments ship with cross-region-replication disabled. The control plane persists a boolean flag ("cross_region_replication": false) in the tenant profile; we will export the tenant profile JSON and a sanitized control-plane audit log showing the flag was set at provisioning.
- Durable copies: We use within-region AZ redundancy only (replicated block device fragments within the region). No automated service-level replication to other regions; any manual copy is gated by our change-control and must be customer-approved.
- Artifact: tenant_profile_export.json (sanitized), control_plane_audit.log (filtered events), and AZ mapping statement.

2) Snapshot tombstone & erase evidence
- Tombstone flow: when a tenant requests erase, the snapshot entry in object-store is updated with tombstone=true and tombstone_ts=<RFC3339>. The object-store retains tombstoned metadata for a short verification window (default 7 days) before background collector marks the snapshot for shredding.
- Key destruction: Tenant data is encrypted with a per-tenant data key, wrapped by a KMS/HSM root key. For a certified erase we perform an HSM-backed key-destruct operation and record the KMS audit event.
- Proof bundle: snapshot_tombstone_metadata.json (record of tombstone markers and timestamps), audit_trace.log (signed traces), kms_hsm_audit_excerpt.txt (signed with our internal sig), and an optional signed attestation PDF.

3) Signatures and verifiability
- Signed logs: We will include a signed hash chain for the audit_trace.log (SHA-256 chain with our signing key) so your auditors can verify integrity.
- Timeline: we can assemble the proof bundle and an attestation draft by Oct 21 (EOD). If you need DocuSign-signed attestation, allow one additional business day.

Attachments included for your review: snapshot_audit_checklist.pdf (checklist of artifacts we produce), crypto_wipe_playbook.docx (internal playbook excerpt — redacted for customer consumption).

Let me know if you need anything more granular (e.g., KMS request ids sliced by timestamp).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
